title: Ruth as a type of the Gentiles and the legal problem of her entry
english: And the name of the second was Ruth. Ruth bears a type of the Gentiles, for she left behind her ancestral customs and was joined to the Israelite way of life. But we must ask how Ruth, being a Moabite, entered the assembly of God when the law forbids a Moabite from entering. And seeking this, I apply the saying: “The law is not laid down for the righteous, but for the lawless and disobedient” (1 Timothy 1:9).

orientation: Origen opens his commentary on Ruth by identifying Ruth as a type of the Gentiles and then raises the legal difficulty that the law forbids a Moabite from entering the assembly of God.
